translations.web: “ ‘But if she is cleansed of her discharge, then she shall count to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
translations.bsb: When a woman is cleansed of her discharge, she must count off seven days, and after that she will be ceremonially clean.
translations.kjv: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
translations.asv: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
